resources.string: Android sensor service is unavailable.
Sensor operation must be list, read or sample.
The requested sensor is not available on this phone.
Provide the sensorType returned by the sensor list.
Android could not start this sensor subscription.
Grant the required activity or body-sensor permission in Android settings.
Android location service is unavailable.
Location operation must be status, current or sample.
Location provider must be auto, gps, network or passive.
Grant location access in Android settings.
GPS requests require precise location access.
Enable system location and the requested location provider.
This phone does not expose an infrared transmitter.
Infrared operation must be status or transmit.
Android did not grant infrared transmission permission.
Use 1–4096 positive pulse durations in microseconds, totalling less than two seconds.
The carrier frequency is outside the transmitter’s reported ranges.
Provide the infrared carrier frequency in Hz.
The requested infrared sequence exceeds ten seconds.
Infrared transmission stopped. Already emitted signals cannot be recalled.
Android did not confirm the infrared transmission. Check the returned emission counts before continuing.
